info.title: Weather Station Aggregation API
info.description: Stream UTF-8 JSON Lines to aggregate temperatures. Use Authorize to supply X-Api-Key for Try it out. Documentation itself requires X-Api-Key or browser Basic login (username apikey, password your API key). Credentials are never embedded in this document. Use HTTPS outside local development.

post.description: Each line is an object with exactly stationName (1–100 decoded UTF-8 bytes) and temperature (-99.9 to 99.9, exactly one fractional digit, no exponent). Matching is ordinal-ignore-case. Output names use invariant word capitalization and preserve punctuation. Results are sorted using ordinal-ignore-case with an ordinal tie-breaker. Mean rounds once to one decimal, midpoint away from zero. Empty input returns an empty body. Stops on the first invalid line without partial successful results. LF, CRLF, and a missing final newline are accepted. The Swagger editor sends raw JSONL text; do not wrap it in quotes or an array. Use the streaming console client for large uploads.

schema.description: A stream of Measurement objects, one per line; see the Measurement schema.

200.description: One StationResult JSON object per line. Values render with one fractional digit. A broken response must be treated as a failed request.
Service is running; does not guarantee free processing capacity.

get.description: Counters reset on restart. Includes completed/rejected HTTP requests, active aggregations (including response streaming), accepted measurements from fully validated uploads, cumulative HTTP duration, and sampled temporary database/journal bytes. A snapshot excludes its own still-running request. Concurrent values are approximate. This JSON endpoint is not a Prometheus exporter. Native .NET instruments are available through the WeatherAggregation meter.

RequestId.name: X-Request-Id
RequestId.description: Optional correlation ID: 1–64 ASCII letters, digits, dots, underscores, or hyphens. Invalid or multiple values are replaced with a generated ID.
Correlation ID for this request and its logs.

temperature.description: Lexically exactly one fractional digit, no exponent.

InvalidInput.description: invalid_measurement: invalid encoding, schema, name, or temperature.

Unauthorized.description: unauthorized: missing, invalid, or duplicate API key.

Limit.description: line_too_long or measurement_limit: configured limit exceeded.

StorageLimit.description: storage_limit or storage_or_io_failure: insufficient or unavailable temporary storage.
